notes.title: Update Feb. 07, 2021
notes.content:
[list][*] Now the game officially supports Simplified Chinese(简体中文).

[*] The ending credit has been updated.

[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the 'Hungry Raccoon' mini game.[/list]

[*] Lowered the difficulty of the 'Hungry Raccoon' mini game.[/list]
